boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study environments at Mercy College and Toledo Lucas County Public Library, with current access details where published.

cards.title: Mercy College Library
cards.subtitle: Sixth Floor Jefferson, Mercy College of Ohio
cards.notes: Bring coursework to the sixth-floor library for its physical collection, computers, printing, and help from library staff.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with study support, computers, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College identifies its Library on the sixth floor of Jefferson and lists computers, free black-and-white and color printing, and study use among its highlights.
cards.access_notes: Usually open Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; Mercy says hours may vary and directs visitors to check the library website.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Sixth floor, Mercy College of Ohio
cards.notes: Use the renovated sixth-floor commons when you want to work near the library and classrooms; bring a charged device.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus commons adjoining Mercy’s new library area.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy says the sixth-floor renovation includes a Learning Commons and that the nearby Health Science Library provides collaborative and private study areas with wired furniture.
cards.source_title: Mercy College of Ohio Unveils New Library with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Located within Mercy’s sixth-floor renovation; follow current College building-access guidance.

cards.title: Main Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Toledo Lucas County Public Library Main, 325 Michigan St.
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused solo session or a small project group; keep the group to four people or fewer.
cards.short_summary: Reservable small-group rooms at downtown Toledo’s Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Library states that its study rooms are free, serve one to four people, and can be reserved by checking availability or calling the library.
cards.source_title: Main Library – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; open Monday–Tuesday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m., Wednesday–Thursday noon–8:30 p.m., and Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

cards.title: Computers and Media Collaboration Rooms
cards.subtitle: First floor, Main Library
cards.notes: Ask at Computers and Media for a collaboration room when a laptop-connected large display would help your group review work.
cards.short_summary: Two display-equipped rooms inside Main Library’s computer area.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Library says its first-floor Computers and Media area has two collaboration rooms with laptop computers and mounted large digital displays.
cards.source_title: Main Library – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Request use in person at Computers and Media or call 419-259-5200; use during Main Library open hours.

cards.entity_name: Joseph and Judith Conda School Enrichment Room
cards.title: Joseph and Judith Conda School Enrichment Room
cards.subtitle: George K. Saloff Family Children’s Library, Main Library
cards.notes: Choose this named enrichment room for a change of setting, then check with Main Library staff about availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A named study room within Main Library’s children’s library.
cards.evidence_claim: Toledo Lucas County Public Library identifies the Joseph and Judith Conda School Enrichment Room as a place where students study.
cards.source_title: The Saloff Children’s Library – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Main Library; confirm room availability with library staff.

cards.title: Small Business and Nonprofit Workspace
cards.subtitle: Parking level, Main Library
cards.notes: Use the named workspace for research or project planning, and consult the Main Library map to locate it on the parking level.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed workspace at downtown Toledo’s Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Lucas County Public Library’s Main Library map lists a Small Business and Nonprofit Workspace on the parking level.
cards.access_notes: Use during Main Library open hours; ask the help desk about workspace access or availability.

cards.title: West Toledo Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: West Toledo Branch, 1320 Sylvania Ave.
cards.notes: Head to West Toledo for a quiet room during open hours; rooms are first-come, first-served, so have a backup table in mind.
cards.short_summary: First-come quiet rooms at the West Toledo Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Toledo Branch says quiet study rooms are available first-come, first-served during open hours and that quiet study tables are also available in the main library space.
cards.source_title: West Toledo – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served during open hours: Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

cards.title: Kent Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Kent Branch, 3101 Collingwood Blvd.
cards.notes: Try the Kent Branch when you need a quiet room; arrive during open hours and use an in-library table if rooms are occupied.
cards.short_summary: Quiet rooms and study tables at the Kent Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kent Branch states that quiet study rooms are first-come, first-served during open hours and that quiet study tables are often available in its main library space.
cards.source_title: Kent – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served during open hours: Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

cards.title: Point Place Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Point Place Branch, 2727 117th St.
cards.notes: Use a first-come quiet room at Point Place for concentrated work, or shift to a quiet study table within the branch.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-room option at the Point Place Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The Point Place Branch says its quiet study rooms are first-come, first-served during open hours and notes quiet study tables in the main library space.
cards.source_title: Point Place – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served during open hours: Monday–Tuesday 9 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Wednesday–Friday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

cards.title: King Road Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: King Road Branch, 3900 King Rd.
cards.notes: Use King Road’s quiet rooms during branch hours for independent work, with quiet tables in the main space as an alternative.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study rooms in the King Road Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The King Road Branch states that quiet study rooms are available first-come, first-served during open hours and that quiet study tables are often available in the main library space.
cards.source_title: King Road – Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served during open hours: Monday–Tuesday noon–8:30 p.m.; Wednesday–Friday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
